description: Official US K-12 school directory as JSON, no API key: 102,274 public and 22,510 private schools from NCES (2023-24) with NCES id, district, address, lat/lon, locale, grades, enrollment, teachers and student-teacher ratio. Search by name, city, state or ZIP, schools near a point or ZIP within N miles, one school by NCES id, all schools of a district with totals, bulk 50 queries. Usable from AI agents via MCP. Free: 25 calls/day per IP. Paid: $0.02 per call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/us-schools-api.

district.description: District NCES LEAID (7 digits) or district name (search and district modes), e.g. 0622710 (Los Angeles Unified).

lat.description: near mode: centre latitude (use with lon instead of zip).

level.description: Public schools only: elementary, middle, high, secondary, prekindergarten, other.

mode.description: search = filter by name/city/state/ZIP/district; near = schools within radiusMiles of lat/lon or a ZIP; school = one or more schools by NCES id; district = all schools of a district (LEAID or name) plus a summary row; bulk = up to 50 querie

name.description: Part of the school name, case-insensitive (search mode), e.g. Lincoln.

ncesIds.description: school mode: up to 50 NCES school ids (12-digit public NCESSCH or 8-character private PPIN).

queries.description: bulk mode: up to 50 objects, each one an input of another mode, e.g. {"mode":"near","zip":"10001","radiusMiles":1}. A failing query returns an error row; the others still answer.

radiusMiles.description: near mode: 0.1-50 miles, default 5. Rows are sorted by distanceMiles.

state.description: 2-letter code or full name, e.g. CA or California.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP. search: schools in this ZIP; near: centre of the radius.

name: us_schools_api
title: Schools API - US School Directory & District Lookup
